cultural.vision_reason: A carved and painted wooden speaker's staff with Northwest Coast formline figures (killer whales, human/ancestor figures), attributed by the museum to Heiltsuk makers — a classic ceremonial/status object of this culture.

physical.title: staff
physical.summary: Wood speaker's staff, carved and painted with a succession of figures, from top to bottom: a killer whale, the dorsal fin over the head, with good formline delineation of head, fins and tail; over a figure, hands to the side, with a circular cedar bark head ring; over a cylindrical section for holding; over a second killer whale figure, with additional detail; over a second cylindrical section; over a squatting figure, the hands round the knees, also with a circular cedar bark? headdress; over a skull-like head.
